title: Canonical skills create new commits for harness artifacts; should amend previous commit and re-apply candidate tags
description: After Phase 9 execution, all three canonical skills (spec, run, fix_signal) leave harness artifact files (metrics JSON, run JSON, signal catalogue updates, index.md) uncommitted, or commit them as a separate follow-up commit. This pollutes git log with noise commits and causes the ~25 'Uncommitted path at skill exit' signals observed across multiple runs. The correct behaviour is: after completing the primary work commit, stage any remaining harness artifacts and amend the previous commit (git commit --amend --no-edit). If a candidate tag exists on the amended commit, it must be deleted and re-applied after the amend. This signal consolidates the commit-completeness concern across all canonical skills and supersedes a1000049 and all its symptom signals.
proposed_resolution:
1. Update all three canonical skills (spec.skill.md, run.skill.md, fix_signal.skill.md) to add a final 'harness artifact commit' step after all other work is complete:
   a. Check git status for any dirty harness files (signals/*, metrics/*, runs/*).
   b. If dirty: stage them, run git commit --amend --no-edit.
   c. If a candidate tag exists on HEAD: delete it and re-tag after the amend.
2. Add a commit-completeness rubric criterion: 'git status must be clean on skill exit'.
3. Supersedes a1000049 and the ~25 symptom-level uncommitted-path signals.
